notes: No-argument command emits the default bit list; C sprintbit preserves its trailing space before the final LFCR (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
The empty bitvector uses C sprintbit's "NOBITS " result (R1/R5e/R5h).
An unknown first token emits the invalid-mode preamble and the full mode list with C's trailing space (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
An already-set SHOW_ON bit emits the exact refusal (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
An already-set SHOW_OFF bit emits the exact refusal (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).

Out-of-band socket service (the WHOD daemon port, ported per DP-1415), not the mud command surface: a raw who request to the live listener returns C's exact greeting + "A list of active players on %s:" header (src/whod.c:337-341) with a registered player entry and the Players/Gods tail; the census transports carry no daemon socket, so the focused test is the vehicle (R1/R2/R5e).

The SHOW_SITE "[ ** Unknown ** ]" arm renders when a session's descriptor host string is empty; the census transports (telnet/ws) always carry a peer address and the WHOD daemon socket is outside their surface, so no vehicle can produce it (unit-proof only, DP-1202 class). TestWhodBuildWhoListUnknownSite pins the exact bytes with an empty Host entry and fails if the arm is removed (R1/R5e/R5h).
